name: Sonora

standard.note: Sonora's new plate shows off the state's landscapes: its sierra, valleys and desert.

plates.title: Current design (2025)
plates.fact: Sonora's new plate shows off the state's landscapes: its sierra, valleys and desert.

plates.title: Previous design (about 2014-2025, still valid)
plates.fact: Sonora isn't requiring a swap, so the older design, which ran for more than 11 years, stays valid next to the new one.

plates.title: Eco-friendly vehicles
plates.fact: The 2025 plate series added plates for eco-friendly vehicles.

plates.title: Antique cars
plates.fact: The 2025 series also brought new plates for antique cars.

notes: The official release (Secretaría de Hacienda, April 30 / May 6, 2025) exists at the robot_url and at https://www.sonora.gob.mx/gobierno/acciones/dependencias/presenta-gobierno-de-sonora-nueva-imagen-de-placas-vehiculares-para-el-estado, but Cloudflare blocks both sites, including their images, from the browser and the container. The release's lead image is https://hacienda.sonora.gob.mx/images/2025/05/06/placasjirf_large.jpeg (unverified: it couldn't be opened, and the 'jirf' name suggests a photo of the official Jorge Iván de la Rosa Flores rather than plate artwork). Because the robot may be blocked the same way, consider robot_url unreliable. The eco, antique, disability and border categories come from the announcement as new plate types. Whether each has its own look was not seen.
